name: Daniel Wright

Strong system design and scalability for large-scale event-driven architectures
Production PostgreSQL and Kafka experience with consistency guarantee design

gaps: Limited exposure to frontend and mobile platforms

resumeText: Staff Engineer at Aurora Stream, designing and building the distributed systems backbone that supports millions of concurrent requests.
